## ca2f5aaf9d79

Concrete distribution defect: `generate(0, 0)` returns a grid whose entire center row and center column are 0, and `self_check()` returns no findings. Every canonical input instead has a complete color-7 center cross separating the four 2x2 quadrants. The generator initializes the 5x5 grid with zeros and writes only the four corner quadrants, while the validator never checks the nine separator cells. This changes color 7 from “separator cross plus one hole per quadrant” into “hole marker only,” enabling a training shortcut that does not match the canonical scene grammar. Require row 2 and column 2 to be all 7 in both generation and validation.
